ownerDirection.purposeAndMission: Create a professional, industry-level music production studio accessible from LAMBOCITYRECORDS.com on an iPad or other supported device, allowing artists and producers anywhere to record, edit, mix, master, and complete release-quality songs. The Studio is the digital headquarters of LAMBO CITY Records and should give artists the tools, confidence, and experience of recording in an exclusive major-label studio. It should help artists hear their work with a polished, professional sound and feel valued, supported, and like stars.
qualityAmbition: Aim for professional, release-ready recording, mixing, and mastering capability.
Provide a complete artist and producer workflow, not a generic beat-making toy.
Offer curated, high-quality sound collections and useful production starting points.
Provide professional vocal tools including pitch correction, reverb, delay, and additional effects.
Support the creative character, musicality, and soul associated with great records.
experienceVision: Open LAMBOCITYRECORDS.com on an iPad or supported device.
Tap Studio and enter the LAMBO CITY Records production environment.
Record and produce music with professional tools in one accessible workspace.
Hear polished mixes and masters and have a path to complete songs.
Feel like a valued artist recording at the LAMBO CITY Records headquarters.

designProtection.editInterface: PROTECTED. The current EDIT interface design, layout, and visual identity are approved by the owner and must not be redesigned or replaced.
allowedImprovements: Improve functionality, precision, controls, responsiveness, feedback, accessibility, and reliability.
Add restrained luxury details and realistic studio equipment detail without changing the approved EDIT design or disrupting its workflow.
Improve the underlying systems while preserving familiar placement and behavior.
designProtection.otherInterfaces: Piano, drums/MPC, and MIX & MASTER need their own dedicated interfaces and may be developed further because their designs are not yet considered final.

systemDirection.edit: Preserve current design; improve the production and editing capabilities underneath it.
systemDirection.mixAndMaster: Build a dedicated professional mixing and mastering interface.
systemDirection.piano: Develop a dedicated, improved piano and instrument interface.
systemDirection.drumsAndMPC: Develop dedicated drum and MPC interfaces with clear, complementary purposes.
systemDirection.recordingAndVocals: Provide an end-to-end vocal and recording workflow with professional effects and monitoring.
systemDirection.soundLibrary: Create curated, detailed, original sound banks with high-quality production character and accessible starting points.

labelAndCommunityVision.role: The Studio is the digital headquarters and artist-development environment for LAMBO CITY Records.
longTermCommunity: Artists and producers from different places can participate in the LAMBO CITY Records ecosystem.
Artists can have their own name, profile, in-world character, skins, and outfits.
The environment should help artists feel welcomed, supported, and presented like stars.
Future opportunities may include LAMBO CITY Radio and other label-related pathways.
labelAndCommunityVision.royaltyAndRightsVision: The owner envisions future pathways for eligible artists and works to participate in music-rights and royalty systems, potentially involving PROs such as ASCAP or BMI. This requires separate rights, ownership, metadata, registration, distribution, and legal workflows; Studio access or a recording alone must never be represented as a guarantee of royalties or chart success.
labelAndCommunityVision.phaseStatus: Long-term product vision. Online collaboration, accounts, persistent artist profiles, and community features require a separate phase decision because existing project direction keeps the initial world single-player and defers accounts/backend/multiplayer.

creativeReferences.rule: Use these as broad creative and production-quality references only. Do not imitate protected recordings, copy proprietary presets, or use unlicensed samples. Develop an original LAMBO CITY sound identity.

workspaceArchitecture.name: Central Studio headquarters with dedicated connected workspaces
workspaceArchitecture.entryExperience: Artists enter one central LAMBO CITY Records Studio headquarters, where they can see and continue their current projects.
workspaceArchitecture.sharedSessionRule: All workspaces connect to the same song, project, recordings, transport, and shared production core. Switching workspaces must not create a separate song or lose session state.
designRules: Preserve the approved EDIT interface design and layout.
Develop dedicated interfaces for workspaces whose designs are not final.
Make navigation between workspaces clear and keep the artist oriented within the same Studio project.
workspaceArchitecture.ownerApproval: The owner explicitly selected Option 3 on 2026-11-04.

labelCollaborationModel.name: Real-time collaboration plus asynchronous project sharing
labelCollaborationModel.realTimeCollaboration: Artists can invite other authorized artists or producers into the same Studio project and work together in real time.
labelCollaborationModel.asynchronousCollaboration: Artists can share projects with collaborators who can contribute at different times, with changes saved and tracked safely.
labelCollaborationModel.artistIdentity: The long-term experience includes individual artist identities and profiles, with in-world characters and customizable appearance.
labelCollaborationModel.phaseStatus: Approved long-term product direction. Collaboration is private and invitation-only, controlled by the owner. Do not silently introduce accounts, backend, persistent profiles, shared cloud projects, or multiplayer into the current single-player foundation. Plan and approve those as a distinct architecture and delivery phase.
requiredFutureCapabilities: Secure project sharing and persistent storage
Conflict handling, version history, and recovery
Audio recording and playback synchronization for live collaboration
labelCollaborationModel.ownerApproval: The owner explicitly selected Option C: both real-time collaboration and asynchronous project sharing, on 2026-11-04.

accessPolicy.rule: Real-time co-production and asynchronous project sharing are available only to people the LAMBO CITY Records owner personally selects and invites. Do not make collaboration access public or automatically available to every Studio user.
accessPolicy.permissions: The owner must be able to decide who is invited, which projects they can access, and whether they may view, contribute, record, edit, or manage project content. Define detailed roles and revocation controls in the future collaboration architecture.
accessPolicy.distinction: This restriction applies to the collaborative co-production feature. It does not by itself mean the general Studio or every future artist profile must be invite-only.
accessPolicy.ownerApproval: The owner clarified on 2026-11-04 that collaboration is an exclusive feature for people they personally choose to collaborate with.

experienceModes.browserBasedStudio: Invited collaborators can join a private session through a direct link and use the online Studio interface without having to enter or play the full 3D game. This should support musicians such as guitarists and producers who want to contribute directly to a session.
experienceModes.inWorldStudio: Collaborators who enjoy the game can enter the 3D LAMBO CITY Records environment, appear as their own character, and collaborate in the virtual studio.
experienceModes.bridge: Both experiences connect to the same project and collaboration services. The browser-based session can act as an accessible entry point that may spark interest in exploring the wider 3D world.
experienceModes.ownerApproval: The owner explicitly wants both browser-based non-3D collaboration and immersive in-world collaboration.

artistIdentityAndAvatar.scope: Long-term platform-wide identity system, not only a Studio feature. Everyone who plays LAMBO CITY should have their own account and profile.
artistIdentityAndAvatar.onboarding: Users create an account and choose a unique username that is checked for availability.
artistIdentityAndAvatar.mobileFirst: Profile information and account interactions should be convenient to manage from a mobile phone.

photos.avatarOutcome: The system should use the user's submitted photos as references to create a corresponding in-game 3D avatar.
photos.thirdPhoto: Not yet specified; ask the owner what the third photo should be used for before defining the upload requirements.

artistIdentityAndAvatar.futureCreatorCulture: The owner envisions players and artists capturing and sharing videos of their LAMBO CITY experiences, including posting content to platforms such as YouTube, creating an incentive to participate and discover the wider world.
artistIdentityAndAvatar.phaseStatus: Approved long-term product vision. Do not add accounts, authentication, image uploads, avatar-generation services, persistent profiles, or multiplayer to the current single-player foundation until a separate architecture, privacy/security, moderation, storage, cost, and rollout plan is reviewed and approved.

steps: User submits up to three reference photos: front-facing headshot, full-body photo, and three-quarter or side-view photo.
Generate a personalized character likeness and internal multi-view reference.
Create and optimize a rigged, animation-ready 3D avatar suitable for the LAMBO CITY Three.js world.
Present a preview so the user can review the likeness.
Allow the user to customize clothing, accessories, and appearance before first entering the world.
Require user approval before the generated avatar becomes their active in-game character.
generationWorkflow.qualityPrinciple: Prioritize recognizable individual likeness and personal identity over generic preset avatars. Treat image-to-3D generation, rigging, optimization, and user approval as distinct quality-controlled steps.
generationWorkflow.status: Approved long-term product direction; implementation belongs to the future accounts and avatar platform phase.

unifiedIdentity.rule: One consistent username and account identity follows the player throughout the LAMBO CITY ecosystem, including the 3D world, Studio sessions, project collaboration, artist profile, and future Radio and entertainment experiences.

inWorldNameDisplay.recommendation: Contextual nameplates rather than permanently displaying names above every character.
behavior: Show a player's username above their character when another player is nearby and within a readable viewing distance.
Show the username when a player is selected, approached for interaction, or participating in the same Studio session.
Hide distant nameplates and avoid displaying names constantly when no social interaction is relevant.
Keep presence/status as a separate optional indicator, not a substitute for the username.
inWorldNameDisplay.presenceStatus: Future optional presence states may include Available, In Studio, Recording, and Do Not Disturb. Players should control their visibility and availability.
inWorldNameDisplay.rationale: Preserves immersion and a clean cinematic world while making it easy to recognize and interact with other people.
inWorldNameDisplay.status: Recommended default accepted for initial direction; may be revised by owner after seeing it in the game.

features: Music and projects the artist explicitly chooses to share
profilePage.privacy: Artists control which music, projects, and profile details are public, private, or shared with selected collaborators.

socialFollowing.feature: Players can follow other players within LAMBO CITY.
socialFollowing.futureScale: Start with a clear, manageable profile and follow foundation; expand social features over time under owner direction.
socialFollowing.safeguards: Plan privacy controls, blocking/reporting, moderation, and age-appropriate safety before launching public social features.

artistProfiles.status: Approved long-term platform direction. Do not implement accounts, public profiles, social graph, or backend services in the current single-player foundation without a separately approved architecture and rollout.

features: Browse music those artists explicitly share publicly
Receive updates when followed artists share or release something
Keep private Studio sessions and projects private unless invited

directMessaging.feature: Artists can eventually send direct messages to one another inside LAMBO CITY.
directMessaging.safeguards: Design privacy and message controls, blocking/reporting, moderation, spam prevention, and age-appropriate protections before launch.

socialExperience.rollout: Build the social foundation in stages. Do not implement accounts, messaging, following, or backend services in the current single-player foundation until the separate platform architecture and rollout are approved.

worldAndEnvironmentVision.vision: LAMBO CITY should eventually feel like a living luxury city and destination, not only a music-making game or a Studio environment.
experiences: Explore the city and discover places
Visit businesses and digital real estate
Meet and interact with other artists and players
Discover creative, social, and label-related opportunities
Enjoy the world even when not actively making music
worldAndEnvironmentVision.roleOfStudio: LAMBO CITY Records Studio remains the musical headquarters and a central creative anchor, while the broader city is a complete destination and experience.
worldAndEnvironmentVision.continuity: Build on the existing world and its established architecture. Preserve working areas and systems; expand in deliberate, modular phases rather than replacing the world.

styleAndEvolution.longTermEvolution: Progressively move the city toward the realism and functional depth of Option A over time.
styleAndEvolution.initialCharacter: Begin with the cinematic luxury entertainment atmosphere, spectacular destinations, exclusive experiences, music, events, and visual excitement of Option B, while establishing realistic city foundations.
styleAndEvolution.targetExperience: A realistic, functional luxury city that retains the atmosphere, excitement, and exclusivity of a premium entertainment destination.
progression: Build the city as an exciting luxury destination with memorable places and events.
Increase the realism and usefulness of everyday experiences over successive development phases.
Make buildings, businesses, vehicles, movement, social interactions, and city activities increasingly functional and believable.
Preserve cinematic presentation and exclusive entertainment experiences as realism deepens.
styleAndEvolution.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C and clarified on 2026-11-04 that the long-term development should increasingly scale toward Option A.

playerExperience.exploration: Players can freely explore the city and choose what to do without being forced through a mission or linear progression.
playerExperience.optionalStructure: Offer optional missions, activities, events, invitations, and opportunities for players who want guidance or a reason to explore.
playerExperience.designPrinciple: The city should feel alive and full of possibilities while preserving player freedom. Guided content should enrich exploration, never turn the city into a checklist.
playerExperience.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-04.

ambientCityActivity.principle: The intended destination is a fully living environment in which the city operates independently of the player's immediate interaction. Option C describes the responsible staged development strategy, not a reduction in the ambition.
targetActivities: Businesses operate with believable activity, staff, and customers.
NPCs move through the city with believable routines and purpose.
Vehicles travel naturally through streets and surrounding areas.
Public spaces maintain ambient activity and social energy.
The city continues to feel active even when the player is not nearby or interacting.
progression: Establish convincing ambient activity using performance-conscious systems.
Expand activity patterns, schedules, and interactions across businesses and public spaces.
Progressively develop a fully functioning living city while protecting performance and existing systems.
ambientCityActivity.designConstraint: Build in modular, scalable phases with performance budgets and distance/visibility-aware simulation; preserve the ambition of a fully living city.
ambientCityActivity.ownerApproval: The owner stated on 2026-11-04 that Option B is the desired experience, while recognizing Option C as the right staged development approach.

npcBehavior.principle: NPCs should ultimately feel like individual residents of LAMBO CITY with lives and purposes of their own, rather than decorative background characters. Option C is the staged development strategy; Option B is the intended long-term experience.
targetCapabilities: Contextual reactions to the environment and player activity
Believable ambient movement and activity throughout the city
progression: Begin with convincing ambient movement and simple contextual behaviors.
Expand NPC routines, roles, destinations, and schedules in modular stages.
Develop richer personalities, relationships, and reactive behavior over time.
npcBehavior.designConstraint: Use scalable, performance-conscious simulation, prioritizing detail for nearby or relevant NPCs while maintaining the impression of a living city.
npcBehavior.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C with Option B as the long-term ambition on 2026-11-04.

businessFunctionality.principle: Businesses should ultimately be fully interactive and functional places in the city. Option C is the safe, progressive implementation strategy; Option B is the intended long-term experience, not a reduction in ambition.
targetCapabilities: Work and participate in business activities
Socialize with other players and NPCs
Experience believable staff, customers, and day-to-day operations
progression: Start with carefully selected interactive destinations and reliable core interactions.
Expand each business with additional services, activities, roles, and social interactions.
Progressively develop businesses into fully functioning environments connected to the living city.
businessFunctionality.designConstraint: Build reusable business systems in modular stages, with performance budgets, clear interaction rules, and testing that protects existing world systems.
businessFunctionality.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C with Option B as the long-term ambition on 2026-11-04, emphasizing that the staged approach is about building safely rather than reducing the intended experience.

vehicleAndRoadDirection.selectedDevelopmentApproach: Progressive; initial vehicles are decorative/showcase elements because the current world does not yet have a defined vehicle road network.

immediateScope.vehicles: Prioritize the luxury look, quality, scale, and presentation of vehicle designs before introducing driving systems.
immediateScope.heroVehicle: A light-blue Lamborghini displayed in the street in front of LAMBO CITY Records headquarters, facing toward the boardwalk stores.
immediateScope.privateBoardwalkStreet: Treat this boardwalk street area as private. Make the street wide enough to support a vehicle U-turn.
immediateScope.oppositeBoardwalkStores: Reserve space directly across the street from the existing boardwalk stores, including across from LAMBO CITY Records headquarters, for additional stores.
immediateScope.privateBeachParking: Reserve a private beach parking lot across from LAMBO CITY Records headquarters, connected to the boardwalk, with space for approximately two additional cars.

futureExpansionIdeas: Establish the road path through the boardwalk area after the opposite-side stores and parking layout are in place.
Potentially extend the route into another main street.
Explore future beach apartments and villa areas.
Explore future golfing, jet skiing, and a skateboard park.
Develop and scale vehicle designs and experiences further, potentially with automated code workflows.
vehicleAndRoadDirection.sequencingAndScopeControl: Do not expand into detailed vehicle, road-network, apartment, villa, golf, jet-ski, or skatepark planning during the current direction questionnaire. Preserve these as future ideas and continue the current system-by-system discovery workflow.
vehicleAndRoadDirection.ownerApproval: The owner described this staged vehicle and boardwalk direction on 2026-11-04 and explicitly asked to keep the current workflow moving without getting distracted.

digitalRealEstate.longTermAmbition: A full digital real-estate experience, subject to a legally reviewed ownership and rights structure.
digitalRealEstate.principle: Begin with selected interactive properties and expand progressively. Do not represent a player as legally owning real estate, land, or a property interest unless the underlying legal structure actually establishes and supports that claim.
progression: Start with selected interactive properties and clearly defined in-platform access or use features.
Develop property customization, persistence, and additional experiences as the platform matures.

Only introduce any purchase, ownership, transferable interest, or other property-right claim after qualified legal counsel has reviewed and approved the structure, disclosures, contracts, jurisdictional requirements, and operational obligations.

legalProtection.ownerConcern: The owner wants to understand and establish the legal structure before telling users they own anything, in order to protect the owner and the business.
legalProtection.rule: Do not market or describe a virtual property or other in-game asset as legally owned by a user, or imply title to land or real-world real estate, unless qualified legal counsel confirms that the specific structure and claim are legally supportable. Until then, ownership offerings must remain unavailable and unadvertised.
distinguishRights: In-platform access or permission to use a location
A revocable or limited digital content license
A purchase of digital items or customization rights
A transferable contractual right, if legally structured and permitted
Legally recognized ownership or title, only if separately established and verified
requiredReview: Terms of service, purchase terms, disclosures, and refund rules
Whether any token, security, investment, property, or other regulated-interest rules could apply
Transferability, resale, inheritance, account termination, and dispute handling
Tax, accounting, payment, privacy, and recordkeeping obligations
legalProtection.implementationGate: Future ownership may be architected as a dormant capability, but no ownership feature may be enabled, offered, sold, or advertised until the owner has obtained qualified legal advice and explicitly approved the documented rights model and launch.

digitalRealEstate.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-04 and emphasized that the legal structure must be established and reviewed before LAMBO CITY tells anyone they own a digital property.

futureOwnershipCapability.strategicIntent: Architect the future digital real-estate and other in-game ownership systems so they can support legally defined ownership offerings later, once the owner has established and reviewed the required legal structure.
futureOwnershipCapability.currentAvailability: Not available to users at the current stage.
futureOwnershipCapability.marketing: Do not offer, advertise, promote, sell, or imply the availability of digital real-estate ownership or other ownership rights before the owner explicitly authorizes launch after legal review.
futureOwnershipCapability.architecture: The underlying design may reserve a modular path for future ownership, entitlements, records, permissions, and transfer rules, but dormant capability must remain inaccessible and must not be represented as a current product feature.
futureOwnershipCapability.launchGate: Require qualified legal review, documented rights and obligations, jurisdictional assessment, operational readiness, and explicit owner approval before enabling or advertising any ownership offering.

entertainmentAndEvents.selectedDirection: Support the full range of LAMBO CITY entertainment and social events, including concerts, live performances, parties, and special events.
entertainmentAndEvents.developmentApproach: Build the event experience progressively, beginning with reliable, well-produced event destinations and core interactions, then expanding event variety, scale, participation, and production capabilities.
designPrinciples: Events should feel like meaningful destinations within the living luxury city.
Connect events to the wider world, artist community, businesses, and entertainment identity.
Preserve player freedom: players can discover and attend events without being forced into a linear progression.
Build event systems modularly so different event types can reuse scheduling, venue, presentation, attendance, and interaction capabilities where appropriate.
entertainmentAndEvents.ownerApproval: The owner confirmed on 2026-11-04 that LAMBO CITY should support all of the discussed event types: concerts, live performances, parties, and special events.

organizerModel.name: Official LAMBO CITY events plus approved artist- and player-organized events
organizerModel.officialEvents: LAMBO CITY can organize and operate official concerts, performances, parties, and special events.
organizerModel.communityEvents: Approved artists and players can organize their own events, subject to defined permissions, venue rules, safety requirements, and moderation.

privateCreativeWorkBoundary.rule: Choosing community event organization does not make private Studio sessions, collaborations, recordings, songs, or unfinished projects public.
privateCreativeWorkBoundary.default: Studio projects and collaboration sessions remain private to their owner and explicitly authorized collaborators.
privateCreativeWorkBoundary.publicationGate: A song, recording, project, or private session may be presented at a public event or on the main stage only after the owner or appropriately authorized rights-holders explicitly approve that specific sharing or performance.
privateCreativeWorkBoundary.separation: Event-organizer permissions, project access permissions, and permission to publish or perform creative work are separate controls. Permission to organize an event does not grant access to private Studio projects or permission to use another person's work.

futureRequirements: Define who qualifies as an approved event organizer and how approval is granted or revoked.
Define organizer permissions for scheduling, venue access, invitations, promotion, and event management.
Provide distinct private, unlisted/invitation-only, and public event visibility settings.
Require explicit authorization before using private Studio work in a public performance or event.
Provide moderation, reporting, safety, and event cancellation controls.
organizerModel.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-04: official LAMBO CITY events plus approved artist- and player-organized events. The owner explicitly clarified that private Studio sessions and creative work must not become public automatically. Public sharing or performance requires separate explicit authorization.

audienceExperience.spectatorExperience: Players can attend concerts and performances as spectators and enjoy a complete experience by watching and listening without participating.
audienceExperience.interactiveExperience: Players may optionally interact with performers, socialize, join audience activities, and participate in special event features.
audienceExperience.participationRule: Audience participation is optional. Spectators must always have a complete and satisfying event experience; interactive features enrich the event but are never required.
audienceExperience.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-04: both complete spectator experiences and optional interactive audience participation.

characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.coreRequirement: Every user's character should be able to dance in time with the music, including at concerts, live performances, parties, and other suitable places in the wider LAMBO CITY world.
danceLibrary: A growing library of hip-hop dance styles and moves
Contemporary and trending dance styles, refreshed over time
Different dance choices, energy levels, and expressive styles
characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.musicSynchronization: Character dance movement should respond to the music's beat and timing rather than relying only on unrelated looping animations. Design the system to support beat-aware timing and synchronized group moments.
characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.playerControl: Players choose whether and when their characters dance. Dancing enriches optional participation and must not be required to enjoy an event.
characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.contentRights: Use original choreography, properly licensed dance content, or other appropriately authorized material. Do not assume that trending choreography, recordings, or performances may be copied without permission.
characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.developmentApproach: Build a reusable character dance system and expandable choreography library in stages, with performance-conscious animation and music synchronization.
characterDanceAndMusicInteraction.ownerApproval: The owner confirmed on 2026-11-04 that every user's character should be able to dance on beat to music, with hip-hop and current trending dance styles included in the evolving library.

performerEligibility.officialPerformers: LAMBO CITY may select, book, and present official performers for its own concerts, live performances, parties, and special events.
performerEligibility.communityPerformers: Approved artists and players may perform at LAMBO CITY events using music and creative work they are authorized to perform.
performerEligibility.rightsBoundary: Approval to perform or organize an event does not itself grant rights to use another person's music, recordings, compositions, or private Studio work. Required permissions must be obtained from the appropriate rights-holders for each use.
futureRequirements: Define performer eligibility, application or invitation, approval, and revocation.
Define booking, scheduling, venue, technical, and event-production permissions.
Verify performer authorization and required rights for music and other creative work before public performance.
Keep performer permissions separate from event-organizer permissions, Studio project access, and publication rights.
performerEligibility.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-04: both official LAMBO CITY bookings and approved community performers, with appropriate authorization for the music performed.

visibilityModel: Public events are discoverable and open to everyone, subject to any separately defined capacity or event rules.
Exclusive events are limited to invited guests or people who have been explicitly granted access.

invitationAuthority.model: The owner retains centralized control and may authorize approved event organizers to manage invitations only for their own assigned events, within owner-defined limits.
invitationAuthority.ownerControls: The owner can review, override, and revoke organizer delegation and guest access.
invitationAuthority.boundaries: Event invitation authority does not grant global platform, administrator, Studio, private project, or creative publication permissions.

exclusiveEventAccess.ownerApproval: The owner approved public events as open and discoverable, exclusive events as invitation-restricted, and Option C for tightly scoped event invitation delegation on 2026-11-05.

platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.selectedModel: Centralized identity, authorization, and security with tightly scoped delegation
platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.accountIdentity: Each user has a unique account identity and profile. Having an account does not automatically grant access to restricted events, Studio projects, private collaborations, properties, or administrative functions.
platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.authorizationPrinciple: Default deny and least privilege. Every protected resource and action must be authorized by trusted server-side services; hiding a control in the client interface is never sufficient security.
platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.ownerAuthority: The LAMBO CITY owner retains ultimate authority over platform-wide security policy, global roles, administrator appointments, security controls, and emergency access. The owner can review, override, and revoke delegated permissions.

eventDelegation.model: Approved event organizers may invite, review, and remove guests only for the specific events they are authorized to manage, and only within owner-defined limits.
boundaries: Event-level delegation does not grant access to other events.
Event organizers cannot grant Studio access, access private projects or recordings, or authorize publication or performance of another person's creative work.
Event organizers cannot grant global roles, appoint administrators, alter platform-wide permissions, disable security protections, or override owner policy.
Delegated permissions must be reviewable, limited in scope, and revocable by the owner.
eventDelegation.ownerApproval: The owner approved centralized security with narrowly scoped event-level delegation on 2026-11-05.

accessGrantRecords: Expiration, revocation status, and revocation authority
authenticationAndAccountProtection: Use strong authentication, with passkeys and/or multi-factor authentication where appropriate.
Protect account recovery, sessions, and device management against takeover.
Apply rate limits, abuse detection, and protections against automated credential attacks.
Use passkey-first, passwordless sign-in as the preferred account authentication method, supporting platform biometrics, device PIN, and other passkey-compatible authenticators.
Use verified email as a protected account recovery and security-notification channel; recovery must use time-limited, abuse-resistant verification and must not silently bypass account protections.
Require step-up verification for sensitive account changes, recovery changes, new-device trust decisions, and other high-risk actions.
Provide user-visible session and device management, including the ability to revoke sessions on devices the user no longer trusts.

Issue one-time backup recovery codes to users during account setup or security enrollment; store only protected verifiers server-side, show the codes securely once, and allow users to regenerate them with appropriate verification.
securityMonitoringAndAudit: Record security-relevant events such as failed sign-ins, suspicious sessions, permission changes, invitation activity, and denied access attempts.
Provide owner-facing access reviews and alerts for suspicious activity.
Protect audit records against unauthorized alteration and apply privacy-conscious retention limits.
platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.securityExpectation: Use layered safeguards and incident-response processes to reduce unauthorized access risk. Do not promise that hacking or unauthorized access can be made impossible.
platformIdentityAndAccessSecurity.implementationGate: This is approved product direction, not authorization to bolt accounts, authentication, backend services, or multiplayer onto the current single-player foundation. Design and approve the platform security architecture, privacy controls, operational plan, and rollout before implementation.

authenticationDecision.name: Passkeys first
authenticationDecision.primarySignIn: Passkey-based passwordless authentication using supported biometrics, device PIN, or another compatible authenticator.
authenticationDecision.recovery: Verified email with protected, time-limited recovery verification and additional safeguards for high-risk recovery.
authenticationDecision.sensitiveActions: Require step-up verification for sensitive account changes and suspicious sign-in situations.
authenticationDecision.sessionManagement: Allow users to review active sessions/devices and revoke sessions they no longer trust.
authenticationDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option A on 2026-11-05.

accountRecoveryDecision.name: Verified email recovery plus one-time backup recovery codes
accountRecoveryDecision.verifiedEmailRecovery: Provide a protected, time-limited email verification flow. Email recovery must not silently bypass passkey protections or high-risk identity checks.
accountRecoveryDecision.backupRecoveryCodes: Provide individually usable, one-time backup codes for users to store securely. Each code is invalidated after use; users can regenerate a new set after re-authentication and invalidate the previous set.
accountRecoveryDecision.highRiskRecovery: Apply additional identity and risk checks for unusual or high-impact recovery attempts, notify the user through established security channels, and protect against recovery-channel changes being used for immediate takeover.
accountRecoveryDecision.recoveryAfterLoss: Define a safe fallback procedure for users who lose all passkeys and cannot access their verified email; do not promise automatic recovery without sufficient proof of account control.
accountRecoveryDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05.

newDeviceVerificationDecision.name: Risk-based new-device verification
newDeviceVerificationDecision.normalSignIn: A valid passkey may authenticate a sign-in from a new device without requiring an additional email challenge solely because the device is new; send a security notification through established channels.
newDeviceVerificationDecision.elevatedRisk: Require additional verification when device, session, sign-in behavior, recovery state, or other risk signals indicate suspicious or unusual activity. Do not grant protected access until required checks pass.
newDeviceVerificationDecision.safeguards: Apply rate limits, session protections, user-visible device/session review, and the ability to revoke sessions. Do not treat a device as trusted solely because it has previously appeared.
newDeviceVerificationDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05.

securityAlertDecision.name: Email and in-app security alerts with permanent account history
securityAlertDecision.importantEventNotifications: Send notifications through both verified email and in-app alerts for important security events, including new sign-ins, suspicious sign-in or recovery attempts, and sensitive account or permission changes. Use risk-aware urgency and clear event details so users can recognize activity they did not initiate.
securityAlertDecision.securityCenter: Provide a security area inside each user's account with a persistent history of security events, including sign-ins, recovery activity, session and device changes, and important account or permission changes. Let users review relevant details and take supported protective actions, such as revoking an unfamiliar session.
deliveryPrinciples: Use both email and in-app channels; neither channel replaces the other.
Keep the in-account security history available after transient notifications are dismissed.
Protect notifications from exposing secrets, recovery codes, or sensitive authentication data.
Use verified contact channels and appropriate safeguards when account recovery or contact details change.
Define event severity, delivery timing, retention, user controls, and incident-response escalation in the future security architecture.
securityAlertDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05: both notifications for important security events and a persistent security history inside each account.

compromisedAccountResponseDecision.name: Adaptive emergency protection
compromisedAccountResponseDecision.responsePolicy: Adjust the response to the severity and confidence of the threat. For serious suspected compromise, automatically revoke suspicious sessions, temporarily restrict sensitive account actions, require appropriate identity verification before restoring protected actions, and notify the account holder through established channels. For lower-risk signals, alert the user and request additional verification where warranted without unnecessarily interrupting legitimate access.
safeguards: Use risk-based thresholds and avoid treating a single weak signal as proof of compromise.
Preserve a safe, accessible recovery path for the legitimate account holder.
Log protective actions and provide clear explanations to the user.
Keep emergency controls and incident-response procedures under the platform's security policy and owner oversight.
compromisedAccountResponseDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05: adaptive emergency protection based on threat severity.

phoneNumberPolicyDecision.name: Verified phone number for account security; separate optional marketing consent
phoneNumberPolicyDecision.accountPhoneNumber: Require users to provide and verify a phone number as part of the future account security and contact model. Explain the security purposes clearly and protect the number as sensitive personal information.
phoneNumberPolicyDecision.marketingConsent: Promotional and community marketing communications are optional and require a separate, affirmative opt-in. Account creation, phone verification, and access to core account features must not be conditioned on agreeing to marketing messages.

communicationPurposes.security: Use the verified number for appropriate account-security and verification communications, subject to the future authentication and recovery design.
communicationPurposes.marketing: Use the number for event announcements, promotions, exclusive experiences, and other marketing only when the user has separately opted in. Provide clear opt-out and preference controls.
communicationPurposes.businessAnalytics: Use aggregated, privacy-protective audience size and engagement statistics for business planning and partnership negotiations. Do not expose or sell individual phone numbers as a community-leverage strategy.

safeguards: Provide clear notice explaining why a phone number is required and how it will be used.
Collect only the minimum data needed; protect phone numbers with encryption, strict access controls, and retention limits.
Provide a secure process to update or remove a phone number, with an alternative account-security and recovery path where feasible.
Do not use phone numbers for marketing without separate consent; honor opt-outs and applicable messaging laws.
Design non-SMS alternatives for users who cannot receive SMS, and do not make SMS the sole factor for high-risk account recovery.
Do not share identifiable contact lists with sponsors, advertisers, artists, or partners without a separate lawful basis and explicit user authorization.
phoneNumberPolicyDecision.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option B on 2026-11-05: phone verification for account security, with marketing communications separately optional.

communityAudienceGrowth.name: Open public community with an exclusive invitation-based tier
communityAudienceGrowth.publicCommunity: Anyone may discover LAMBO CITY and join the public community through the published onboarding and access rules. Public participation should support organic discovery, artist connections, events, and community growth.
communityAudienceGrowth.exclusiveCommunity: LAMBO CITY may also offer invitation-based access to designated exclusive experiences, events, artist opportunities, and other benefits. Invitations and special access must be explicitly granted and governed by scoped permissions.
growthStrategy: Support organic growth through the quality of the world, Studio, events, artists, and experiences.
Allow users to invite friends through clear, abuse-resistant invitation flows.
Build exclusive experiences as an additional community layer, not as a replacement for public access.
Keep public membership, exclusive invitations, event access, Studio collaboration, and administrative permissions as distinct entitlements.
Use aggregated, privacy-protective audience and engagement metrics to understand growth and support business negotiations.
safeguards: Do not imply that joining the public community grants access to restricted events, private Studio projects, or administrative capabilities.
Do not sell, share, or expose personal contact information as a growth or partnership tactic.
Define eligibility, invitation limits, expiration, revocation, and abuse prevention for exclusive access before launch.
communityAudienceGrowth.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05: grow an open public community while also developing an exclusive invitation-based community layer.

membershipAndPrivileges.name: LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID with earned or granted Boarding Pass privileges
membershipAndPrivileges.foundation: Every person receives a basic LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID. The ID is universal identification, not elevated membership status.
membershipAndPrivileges.aspirationalCredential: The LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass is the status and access credential users aspire to earn or receive. It may unlock designated experiences and privileges under clearly defined rules.
privilegePathways: Invitation-based Boarding Pass grants from authorized LAMBO CITY authority.
Achievements and meaningful participation that may qualify a user for designated recognition or access.
Artist status and approved creative opportunities.
principles: Do not require paid membership as the default path to belonging or participation in the public community.
Do not treat possession of a basic Yacht Club ID as proof of Boarding Pass status or access to restricted experiences.
Keep ID, Boarding Pass status, achievements, artist status, event invitations, Studio collaboration, and administrative permissions distinct.
Privileges must have explicit scope, eligibility rules, granting authority, and expiration or revocation rules where applicable.
Achievements or reputation must never automatically grant sensitive permissions, private project access, or administrative authority.
Any future paid offerings or membership benefits require separate owner approval, transparent terms, and appropriate legal and operational review.
membershipAndPrivileges.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05 and clarified that the universal identity is a LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID, while the aspirational credential is the LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass.

baseIdentity.name: LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID
baseIdentity.meaning: Every person receives a basic LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID as their unique identity in the ecosystem. The ID identifies the person; it does not itself imply elevated status, membership privileges, or access to restricted experiences.

aspirationalStatus.name: LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass
aspirationalStatus.meaning: The Boarding Pass is the meaningful status and access credential users aspire to earn or receive. It represents recognition, eligibility, or authorization for designated Yacht Club experiences and privileges beyond simply having an ID.
aspirationalStatus.accessRule: A Boarding Pass may carry specific, clearly defined entitlements. It must not automatically grant every restricted event, private Studio project, collaboration, property, or administrative permission.
aspirationalStatus.governance: Define Boarding Pass levels, eligibility, granting authority, benefits, expiration, suspension, and revocation in a later owner-approved design. Keep invitation-based grants, achievements, artist recognition, and event-specific access distinct where needed.

yachtClubIdentityAndBoardingPass.terminologyRule: Use LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID for the universal basic identity and LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass for the aspirational status/access credential. Do not describe the basic ID as a LAMBO CITY account or imply that everyone automatically has a Boarding Pass.
yachtClubIdentityAndBoardingPass.ownerApproval: The owner clarified on 2026-11-05 that everyone has a basic LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID, while the goal is to earn or receive a LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass.

communityReputationAndAchievements.name: Achievements plus a carefully governed reputation system
communityReputationAndAchievements.achievements: Recognize meaningful milestones, positive participation, creative contributions, event participation, and other appropriate accomplishments through visible profile achievements.
communityReputationAndAchievements.reputation: Develop a reputation system that recognizes trustworthy, constructive, and meaningful community participation rather than raw popularity.
safeguards: Do not allow users to buy reputation or influence.
Do not equate follower counts, wealth, paid status, or popularity with trustworthiness.
Use transparent criteria, abuse-resistant signals, and a way to review or appeal consequential reputation decisions.
Protect users from brigading, retaliation, harassment, fake accounts, and coordinated reputation manipulation.
Do not let reputation scores automatically grant administrative powers, private Studio access, or unrestricted event access.
Keep public-facing reputation indicators privacy-conscious and avoid exposing sensitive moderation or security details.
communityReputationAndAchievements.relationshipToBoardingPass: Achievements and reputation may contribute to eligibility for certain recognition or Boarding Pass pathways, but they do not automatically issue a Boarding Pass or replace explicit authorization for restricted resources.
communityReputationAndAchievements.ownerApproval: The owner selected Option C on 2026-11-05: visible achievements plus a carefully designed reputation system recognizing trustworthy, constructive, and meaningful community participation.

yachtClubBoardingPassVision.coreVision: The LAMBO CITY Yacht Club Boarding Pass is an aspirational credential associated with earning eligibility for the BIG LAMBO CITY Yacht Club parties and other specifically designated exclusive Yacht Club experiences. It should feel prestigious, meaningful, and earned rather than like an ordinary account badge.

inGameWealthMilestone.rule: A player must earn or make at least $100,000 in game cash to become eligible for consideration for a Boarding Pass.
inGameWealthMilestone.qualificationOnly: Reaching $100,000 is a required eligibility milestone, not an automatic award or guarantee of a Boarding Pass.

eligibility.additionalQualities: Other qualities, achievements, conduct, meaningful participation, reputation, or owner-approved criteria also matter. The exact criteria, evaluation process, granting authority, and any Boarding Pass levels remain to be designed and approved by the owner.
eligibility.antiPayToWinPrinciple: The $100,000 milestone refers to cash made in the game. It must not be silently replaced by buying status with real money. Any future paid offering requires separate owner approval, transparent terms, and legal and operational review.

exclusiveExperience.events: Major, high-profile LAMBO CITY Yacht Club parties and other invitation-only experiences, with music, entertainment, networking, and a glamorous luxury social atmosphere.
exclusiveExperience.yachts: A tiered collection of luxury yachts and yacht experiences across LAMBO CITY, with multiple levels of scale, exclusivity, and prestige to be designed.
exclusiveExperience.community: Aspirational networking and social spaces where players may encounter successful entrepreneurs, artists, wealthy in-world players, AI innovators, crypto and NFT participants, and holders or builders of digital-real-estate portfolios. These are community themes and fictional/in-world roles, not promises that real-world celebrities, investors, or wealthy individuals will participate.
exclusiveExperience.atmosphere: A sophisticated, glamorous, adult social environment with stylish characters, entertainment, and opportunities to meet people. Participation and social interaction remain optional and must respect consent, privacy, and community safety.

futureMarketplace.vision: A future LAMBO CITY marketplace where players may create value, participate in commerce, and potentially earn money through clearly defined in-game systems.
futureMarketplace.status: Long-term direction only; not a currently implemented or promised feature.
futureMarketplace.safeguards: Design the economic model, permitted activities, anti-fraud protections, ownership and licensing rules, payment and withdrawal mechanics, tax and regulatory obligations, and user disclosures before offering real-money earning or making financial claims. Do not promise income, investment returns, or guaranteed monetization.

accessAndGovernance: A Boarding Pass grants only the specific experiences and privileges expressly assigned to it.
Possessing a Boarding Pass does not automatically grant access to every private event, Studio project, collaboration, property, marketplace function, or administrative permission.
Keep the universal LAMBO CITY Yacht Club ID separate from Boarding Pass status.
Keep Boarding Pass eligibility separate from the final award decision and from event-specific invitations or permissions.
Define levels, benefits, eligibility review, granting authority, duration, suspension, revocation, and appeal or review procedures in a later owner-approved design.
yachtClubBoardingPassVision.ownerIntent: The owner described the Boarding Pass as the ticket toward the BIG LAMBO CITY Yacht Club parties and future exclusive experiences, with a minimum $100,000 earned in-game cash milestone plus additional qualities. The owner also described a future marketplace and a luxury social scene involving yachts, influential entrepreneurial and technology communities, crypto/NFT participants, and digital-real-estate portfolio holders.

creatorEconomyRecognitionAndMedia.coreVision: LAMBO CITY should create meaningful pathways for producers, artists, and other contributors to build careers, sell creative work, gain recognition, rank on public charts, and grow their reputation within the ecosystem.

creatorRecognition.producerSales: Track legitimate beat and other approved producer-product sales as measurable milestones. Producers who reach defined sales levels and bring customers and positive attention to LAMBO CITY should receive meaningful recognition and incentives.
creatorRecognition.artistRecognition: Create comparable recognition pathways for artists and other creator categories, using metrics appropriate to their contributions rather than forcing every role into one measure.
creatorRecognition.respectAndReputation: Respect matters. Recognition should consider trustworthiness, quality, reliability, creativity, collaboration, positive conduct, and meaningful contribution in addition to commercial performance.
creatorRecognition.incentiveTypes: Potential incentives include milestone awards, profile achievements, increased visibility, featured placements, invitations, creator opportunities, and consideration toward defined Yacht Club Boarding Pass eligibility. Exact rewards and thresholds require later owner approval.
creatorRecognition.integrity: Use transparent metric definitions and anti-fraud protections. Do not equate sales, wealth, followers, or popularity alone with trustworthiness or automatic access to sensitive privileges.

chartsAndRankings.vision: Create Billboard-style rankings and charts within LAMBO CITY for producers, artists, and other relevant creator categories.
possibleMeasures: Verified beat and approved creative-product sales
Artist releases and legitimate listening or engagement activity where available
Meaningful audience growth and community participation
Creative milestones, collaborations, and quality contributions
Trust and conduct signals under transparent, privacy-conscious rules
chartsAndRankings.governance: Define separate charts by creator role and metric, transparent time windows and eligibility rules, verified transaction and engagement signals, anti-bot and anti-manipulation controls, correction and appeal processes, and privacy protections. Avoid presenting a single opaque popularity score as a complete measure of a creator's worth.

displayAndDistribution.approvedDirection: Present the connected creator rankings publicly in all three places: the LAMBO CITY Jumbotron, individual creator profiles, and a dedicated Billboard-style chart destination/area within the city.
displayAndDistribution.jumbotron: Use rotating and scheduled chart highlights, creator spotlights, milestones, and chart movement to create public excitement and discovery.
displayAndDistribution.creatorProfiles: Show each creator's verified achievements, relevant chart positions, milestones, and progress while respecting privacy and profile visibility controls.
displayAndDistribution.billboardDestination: Provide a dedicated in-world destination where visitors can browse category-specific charts, discover creators, and explore current and historical rankings.
displayAndDistribution.governance: Keep multiple role- and metric-specific charts rather than relying on one overall leaderboard. Define transparent metric definitions, time windows, eligibility rules, verified signals, anti-manipulation controls, corrections/appeals, and privacy safeguards.

periods.name: Weekly charts
periods.purpose: Highlight creators making meaningful moves right now and give emerging talent frequent opportunities for recognition.
periods.window: Rolling or calendar-week period to be defined during implementation.

periods.name: Monthly charts
periods.purpose: Recognize sustained performance and consistency across a broader period.
periods.window: Monthly period to be defined during implementation.

periods.name: All-time charts
periods.purpose: Preserve the historical record of major achievements, sales milestones, and lasting contributions to LAMBO CITY.
periods.window: Lifetime verified totals or milestones, with clear metric definitions and correction procedures.

timePeriods.governance: Display the applicable time window and metric definitions clearly. Use verified activity, anti-fraud controls, transparent eligibility rules, privacy safeguards, and correction/appeal processes. Weekly and monthly charts should create opportunities for emerging creators without erasing all-time history.

marketplaceAndRevenue.vision: A future marketplace where producers and other creators can offer approved creative products and services, including beats, to customers within the LAMBO CITY ecosystem.
marketplaceAndRevenue.platformRevenue: LAMBO CITY Records is intended to receive a commission from eligible marketplace sales.
marketplaceAndRevenue.requirements: Before launch, clearly disclose commission rates, seller payouts, refunds, chargebacks, transaction fees, tax responsibilities, licensing and usage rights, ownership representations, prohibited listings, dispute handling, and payment operations. Obtain appropriate legal and operational review.
marketplaceAndRevenue.status: Long-term product direction only; not a currently implemented marketplace or a promise of earnings.

jumbotronMediaNetwork.vision: Use the LAMBO CITY Jumbotron as a recurring media and educational channel for artists, producers, and the wider community.
content: Music-business education and practical guidance for scaling as an artist or producer
Producer and artist spotlights, rankings, milestones, and success stories
Interviews, podcast-style segments, discussions, and community announcements
Information about opportunities, marketplace participation, and ways to grow within LAMBO CITY
jumbotronMediaNetwork.automatedWorkflow: Explore a future workflow that researches, drafts, assembles, and schedules recurring podcast-style episodes and news/education segments for the Jumbotron.
jumbotronMediaNetwork.editorialSafeguards: Automated content must be checked for accuracy, dates, source quality, rights to music/images/clips, fair presentation, sponsorship disclosure, and misleading financial or career claims. Require editorial approval before publication, especially for news, rankings, financial topics, and claims about real people or businesses.

creatorEconomyRecognitionAndMedia.ownerIntent: The owner wants producer beat sales and other creator achievements to create incentives and recognition, with respect as an important factor. The owner envisions a Billboard-style ranking system for producers, artists, and other creators; a future marketplace in which LAMBO CITY Records receives a commission on sales; and an automated podcast/news/educational media workflow on the LAMBO CITY Jumbotron to help musicians and producers learn how to grow. The owner approves displaying the connected Billboard-style charts publicly on the LAMBO CITY Jumbotron, within creator profiles, and in a dedicated Billboard-style chart destination in the city. Creator incentives should be personalized to users' interests and roles, potentially including producer sound banks, plugins, instruments, recording tools, and other relevant unlocks. The system may learn from voluntary profile preferences and privacy-conscious use of platform features, while allowing users to update or disable personalization. The owner approves three chart periods for the Billboard-style ranking system: weekly charts for current momentum, monthly charts for sustained performance, and all-time charts preserving historical achievements and contributions.

personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.vision: Creator incentives should reflect each user's interests, creative role, goals, and chosen development path rather than awarding identical rewards solely based on rank.
personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.interestDiscovery: Let users voluntarily select and update interests, creator roles, and goals during onboarding and in profile settings. Over time, the system may use privacy-conscious signals from their LAMBO CITY activity, such as Studio tools they choose to use, projects they create, products they sell, events they attend, and opportunities they pursue, to recommend relevant rewards.

producers: Additional beat sounds and sound banks
Studio production features and learning opportunities
communityContributors: Approved opportunities to contribute or organize

personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.rewardDesign: Rewards may include earned unlocks, access to tools, learning resources, visibility, promotional opportunities, invitations, and creator opportunities. Match rewards to user interests while preserving meaningful achievement milestones and fair access.
personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.userControlAndPrivacy: Users should be able to review, change, or disable personalization. Explain which activity signals are used, minimize data collection, avoid sensitive inferences, and do not make consequential access decisions solely through opaque profiling.
personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.safeguards: Do not allow purchased rank, popularity, or automated profiling alone to confer trust, administrative authority, private project access, or unrestricted event access. Keep reward eligibility, Yacht Club Boarding Pass authorization, and security permissions distinct.
personalizedCreatorProgressionAndRewards.status: Long-term product direction; reward catalogs, unlock criteria, data model, consent controls, and implementation require separate design and owner approval.

openDecisions: Define direct-message permissions, message requests, notification controls, and whether messaging is limited to mutual follows or approved contacts.
Define profile visibility defaults, public/private music sharing, and who can follow or message whom.
Define safety, moderation, blocking/reporting, and age-appropriate controls for the future social layer.
Define the third profile photo's purpose and the exact photo requirements for avatar generation.
Define account onboarding, username rules, profile privacy, image consent and retention, and avatar review/editing controls.
Design a shared project/session architecture supporting both browser-only collaboration and immersive 3D collaboration.
Define the owner-controlled invitation workflow, collaborator roles, project-level permissions, and access revocation for private collaboration.
Define the central Studio entrance and the artist journey from opening Studio through creating, recording, editing, mixing, mastering, and exporting a song.
Define the professional acceptance standard for recording, mixing, mastering, latency, and exports.
Define which features are essential for the first complete Studio release versus later expansion.
Obtain qualified legal review and define the rights model, disclosures, and jurisdictional obligations before offering any digital real-estate ownership or making ownership claims.
For the future entertainment and events system, define event hosting, scheduling, capacity, audience participation, artist access, and moderation requirements.
Define eligibility and approval/revocation rules for artist- and player-organized events, plus event-level visibility and publishing permissions.

Define detailed authentication, account recovery, session/device management, security-alert severity and delivery timing, audit-log retention, incident response, and access-review requirements for the future identity and security architecture.

Define recovery-code enrollment, secure display and storage guidance, regeneration and invalidation, high-risk recovery verification, security notifications, and fallback procedures when users lose both passkeys and verified email.
Define risk signals, notification channels, step-up verification methods, trusted-device lifecycle, and user controls for new-device and suspicious sign-ins.

Define the phone verification provider and supported non-SMS alternatives, phone-number change and recovery safeguards, data retention and deletion periods, consent records, messaging frequency controls, and applicable privacy and messaging-law requirements.
protectionRules: Do not redesign the approved EDIT interface.
Do not replace working audio engines or create duplicate project/transport systems.
Inspect current modules before making changes.
Develop piano, drums/MPC, and MIX & MASTER as dedicated interfaces connected to shared production services.
Do not promise chart placement, commercial success, or royalty eligibility.
Require owner approval before changing the Studio's approved visual direction or expanding into accounts, backend, or multiplayer.

Treat platform-wide accounts, profiles, photo uploads, generated 3D avatars, browser-based sessions, and in-world multiplayer as a future coordinated platform phase; do not bolt them onto the current single-player architecture without an approved design.
Use uploaded photos as consented avatar references with clear privacy, retention, deletion, and user-control rules; do not promise perfect likeness or automatic generation quality.

Event organizer permissions must remain separate from Studio project access and creative-work publication permissions; private Studio work stays private unless explicitly authorized for sharing or performance.
Enforce authorization server-side for every protected resource and action; never rely on client-side visibility or UI hiding.

Keep event invitation delegation limited to explicitly assigned events; event organizers cannot grant global roles, Studio access, private project access, creative publication rights, or change platform security policy.
The owner retains platform-wide security authority and the ability to review, override, and revoke delegated permissions.
Use default-deny access, least privilege, revocable grants, security audit trails, and privacy-conscious monitoring; do not promise absolute protection from hacking.

approval.note: Captures the owner's direction answers to date. The living-city style is Option C, progressing toward the realism and functionality of Option A; player freedom and optional guided activities are both supported; the ultimate city activity ambition is Option B, delivered progressively using Option C; NPC and business functionality follow Option C as the development approach with Option B as the long-term ambition; vehicle development begins with luxury decorative/showcase presentation while the road network and future interactive driving scope are developed later. This is not yet a complete or approved Studio specification. Digital real estate follows Option C as the staged development approach, with any ownership claims gated on a legally reviewed and owner-approved rights structure. The owner also confirmed that LAMBO CITY should support concerts, live performances, parties, and special events. Future digital-real-estate and other in-game ownership may be architected as dormant capability, but must remain unavailable and unadvertised until legal review and explicit owner launch approval. The owner selected Option C for event organizers: official LAMBO CITY events plus approved artist- and player-organized events. Private Studio sessions and creative work remain private by default; organizer access does not grant project access or publication rights, and public sharing or performance requires explicit authorization. The owner selected Option C for audience experience: a complete spectator experience plus optional interactive participation. The owner also selected Option C for performers: official LAMBO CITY bookings plus approved community performers, subject to the necessary rights and permissions for music performed. The owner further confirmed that every user's character should be able to dance in time with music, with an expandable library of hip-hop and current trending dance styles, while keeping dancing optional and respecting applicable choreography and content rights. The owner approved centralized identity and security with tightly scoped event-level delegation: the owner retains ultimate platform-wide security authority, while approved organizers may manage invitations only for their assigned events within owner-defined limits. Public events are discoverable and open; exclusive events require an invitation or explicit access grant. These are future platform directions and do not authorize implementation of accounts or backend services in the current single-player foundation. The owner selected passkey-first passwordless sign-in (Option A) for the future account system, with verified email as a protected recovery channel, step-up verification for sensitive or suspicious actions, and user-controlled session/device revocation. The owner selected Option C for account recovery: protected verified-email recovery plus one-time backup recovery codes, with additional checks for high-risk recovery and a separately designed fallback for loss of all recovery methods. The owner selected Option C for new-device sign-in: risk-based verification, with security notifications for valid passkey sign-ins and additional checks when device or behavior signals indicate elevated risk.
